summary.en: Watch a flock of AI birds teach themselves Flappy Bird through neuroevolution, live on screen.
summary.zh: 让一群 AI 小鸟用神经进化自己学会玩 Flappy Bird，全程可视化。

description.en: It starts flying the moment it loads: dozens of birds at once, the crashers culled each round, the survivors' brains crossed and mutated into the next generation. Within a few dozen generations they simply never die.
description.zh: 打开即自动运行，几十只小鸟同时飞，撞管的被淘汰，存活者的「大脑」交叉变异出下一代，几十代后就能无限飞。

howto.en: Nothing to press — just watch it learn.

tip.en: Not a game to play but a show to watch — which is exactly why it spreads on social feeds. A perfect hook for an 'AI' corner on your site.
tip.zh: 不是给人玩的，是给人看的——但正是这类 Demo 最容易在社交平台被转发。适合做站点的「AI 专区」引流位。
